title: Wall Audit Failed
unlockCriteria: Breach the Floor 5 outer wall with the Ratings Ram.
details: Unlocks from the authoritative Floor 5 wall-breached goal flag once the breach transaction commits.
directorFlavor: The Ratings Ram filed exactly one complaint and delivered it directly through masonry. Security insists the wall was compliant five seconds ago; the hole says otherwise. Production has reclassified the courtyard as an open-plan workspace. Keep moving before Facilities bills you for structural innovation.

title: Hostile Takeover
unlockCriteria: Capture the throne and finish Floor 5.
details: Unlocks only when the capture transaction succeeds and the run ends as a Floor 5 clear.
directorFlavor: The Crown Auditor signed off in blood, the Regent stopped objecting, and you converted a siege into ownership paperwork. The throne was never decorative; it was a binding clause with excellent acoustics for screaming. Every camera on set just switched from defensive coverage to coronation framing. This floor started as someone else's castle and ended as your liability.

title: Command Post Intact
unlockCriteria: Capture the throne without the Command Post dropping below the approved health floor.
details: Unlocks only when Floor 5 clears and the Command Post health floor gate remains satisfied at terminal capture.
directorFlavor: You ran a full coup while the Command Post stayed pristine enough for investors to call it sustainable. No emergency rebuild segment, no sympathy arc, no desperate overtime montage: just clean execution and immaculate receipts. The audience expected a pyrrhic mess and got a case study in controlled violence instead. Accounting hates this because it means your method scales. Legal hates it because the paperwork now describes success as repeatable. Keep smiling; the sponsors just discovered competence can be marketable.
